sections.title: Tejjel vagy tej nélkül?
sections.content: You know *-val/-vel* (with): *tejjel* (with milk), *cukorral* (with sugar). *Nélkül* is the opposite. Ask which one: *Tejjel vagy tej nélkül?* (With milk or without milk?) *Vagy* means "or". Answer with one of them: *Tej nélkül kérem a kávét.*

sections.title: Both, one after the other
sections.content: Say two things in a row by repeating the pattern: *Tej nélkül kérem a kávét, cukor nélkül a teát.* The second part may leave out the verb, as in English.

items.english: I would like the coffee with milk.
I would like the coffee without milk.
I am going with an umbrella.

sections.content: *Tejjel* has the ending, *tej nélkül* has a separate word. With *nélkül* the noun is always bare.
